I swore it loud enough for shore,
Then ducked beneath the tavern door.
The keeper eyed my Sunday coat,
My solemn face, my thirsty throat.
I said, I'm through with drinking, Jack—
He reached to put the bottle back.

[Chorus 1]
One more round, just one more round,
Before these boots take solid ground.
I've packed my sins, I've paid my fare;
My better life is waiting there.
One more round, then cast me free—
Don't let that fellow order for me.
That fellow's me.

[Verse 2]
The bosun brought a farewell cake;
We drank a toast for old times' sake.
The carpenter proposed my health;
I toasted that proposal myself.
A crooked song rose down below:
the men be hung, horses go
I bent the words till rafters shook,
Then lost my place and blamed the book.

[Chorus 2]
One more round, boys, one more round!
We'll send my wicked habits down!
I'll quit when that old bell strikes ten—
Who wound the bloody thing again?
One more round, then cast me free—
The harbor keeps revolving round me.
Stand still, you sea.

[Verse 3]
My daughter's letter warmed my vest:
Come home by dawn. You know the rest.
She'd drawn our gate, the apple tree,
A little space beside her knee.
I smoothed the paper with my thumb,
Then heard another barrel come.
My mouth was halfway through the cheer
Before I knew what brought me here.

[Chorus 3]
One more round! A mighty round!
Wake every sleeper in this town!
Bring up the cups! Strike up the band!
I've got tomorrow in my hand!
One more round—
One more...
There's ink upon my drinking hand.

[Bridge]
I read that letter by the door.
The room went sailing on once more.
Old Jack said, Leaving? Take your change.
The quiet street looked wide and strange.
I nearly turned. I knew the tune.
It followed underneath the moon:
the men be hung, horses go
I sang it soft and took it slow.

[Final Chorus]
One more round—the windows cried.
I kept my boots on the outside.
One more round came down the quay;
I felt it pull and let it be.
I cannot swear for all my days;
Tonight I walked the other way.
The tide went out.
I stayed ashore.

[Outro]
She heard my key against the door.
I set my wages in the drawer.
Put on the kettle, love, I said.
She took my coat. The sky turned red.

lyrics.text:
[Intro]
I carried a stone through the burning sand
And called it mercy in my hand

[Verse 1]
The stranger came where the candles bent
With a ruined face and a traveler's rent
He shook like a man in a winter room
But the hearth spat teeth and the rafters bloomed
I crawled from the smoke when the others died
He walked to the east and I stayed by his side
Tristram's hero in a borrowed skin
Keeping the door for the thing within

[Pre-Chorus]
One foot forward, one prayer behind
I let his shadow make up my mind

[Chorus]
The stone I carried carried me
Down every road I thought was free
I heard a man beneath the flame
And mercy answered to a demon's name
The stone I carried, burning gold
I couldn't save him, couldn't let go

[Verse 2]
Beyond Lut Gholein, under seven tombs
The air lay still as a shuttered room
Tal Rasha hung where the old chains crossed
A living lock for a kingdom lost
An angel struggled with the friend I knew
The prisoner begged and I reached right through
One broken jewel from a wounded chest
I freed the hunger and damned the rest

[Pre-Chorus]
Tyrael sent me through terror and heat
To break that stone where the hellfires meet

[Chorus]
The stone I carried carried me
Down every road I thought was free
I heard a man beneath the flame
And mercy answered to a demon's name
The stone I carried, burning gold
I couldn't save him, couldn't let go

[Verse 3]
Under Kurast I watched three stand
Hatred welcomed his brothers' hands
The Wanderer split like a rotten seam
And Terror stepped out of a human dream
The gate stood open, the furnace wide
My knees went empty; I stayed this side
I kept the shard and I fled the light
To a locked little room that could never hold night

[Bridge]
Now you sit so still while I tell you why
With an angel's name and a stranger's eyes
Take it, take it, I failed the fire
Your fingers close and your voice climbs higher
That isn't heaven behind your smile
Baal has been listening all this while

[Final Chorus]
The stone I carried carried me
To the last locked door I would ever see
I heard a man beneath the flame
And mercy answered to a demon's name
The stone I carried, burning gold
The hand is empty, the room is cold

[Outro]
I called it mercy in my hand
Now fire remembers who I am

songs.title: Khalim Still Has a Heart (Dark Ska Soul)

lyrics.text:
[Intro]
Ring that bell in the sinking square
Somebody's heart is still beating there

[Verse 1]
The river brought us a fevered dawn
With the temple roofs and the daylight gone
The jungle climbed every merchant's stair
And a priest sold hatred as an answered prayer
We huddled on planks at the edge of town
While the roots pulled another fine house down
Gold on the altar, rot in the grain
The choir kept time with the prisoners' chains

[Pre-Chorus]
Mephisto whispers, the council agrees
But one dead man won't bend his knees

[Chorus]
Khalim still has a heart
They couldn't tear that part apart
An eye for the truth, a mind of his own
A will that won't kneel to a glittering stone
Swing that flail till the false light breaks
Wake up, Kurast, for the living's sake

[Verse 2]
One good priest wouldn't sing their lie
So they scattered the man who could still ask why
His eye lay deep where the spiders fed
His brain where the flayers sheltered their dead
His heart in the sewers beneath our feet
Still worth more than the gold in the street
We gathered the pieces they couldn't command
And carried his answer in a stranger's hand

[Pre-Chorus]
The cube makes whole what the knives divide
There's a harder law than the council's pride

[Chorus]
Khalim still has a heart
They couldn't tear that part apart
An eye for the truth, a mind of his own
A will that won't kneel to a glittering stone
Swing that flail till the false light breaks
Wake up, Kurast, for the living's sake

At Travincal they came robed in fire
With a holy seal on a devil's desire
Their Compelling Orb had a lovely shine
And a thousand mouths saying none are mine
The flail hit once and the spell came loose
Like a blade dragged clean through a velvet noose
Down in the Durance, the river ran red
We followed the hate to the hate that fed

[Bridge]
No shining sermon can wash that floor
No lord below gets to own us anymore
For every small voice they tried to drown
For the folk still breathing outside this town
Keep the eye open, keep the mind clear
Keep that stubborn little heartbeat here

[Final Chorus]
Khalim still has a heart
They couldn't tear that part apart
An eye for the truth, a mind of his own
A will that won't kneel to a glittering stone
Swing that flail till the false light breaks
Wake up, Kurast, for the living's sake

[Outro]
The bell is cracked but it rings through the rain
Khalim's heart beats again

[Intro]
Carry the names down the mountainside
Somebody has to remember the height

[Verse 1]
Harrogath hammered its gates through the snow
While the catapults taught us the language below
Our brothers in cages could hear us draw near
We broke every lock we could reach through the fear
Anya lay frozen where dark waters ran
With a truth in her throat that could shatter a clan
One elder had bargained our birthright away
For the shape of a town he could keep for a day

[Pre-Chorus]
The relic was gone and the oath was sold
Destruction went in from the cold

[Chorus]
When Arreat fell, we were still standing
Ash on our tongues and the dawn in our hands
We saved a world we could not shelter
And lost the mountain that taught us to stand
Carry the names, carry the names
Stone turns to dust but the oath remains

[Verse 2]
Three Ancients woke on the wind-bitten crown
To weigh every foot that would dare travel down
We stood through their trial with our blood on the snow
Then passed where the bearer of relics could go
Then deep in the keep came that terrible laugh
And wave after wave tried to cut us in half
Baal waited smiling beside the red glow
With the heart of the world turning sick down below

[Pre-Chorus]
We brought him to earth but the poison stayed
Victory came with a debt unpaid

[Chorus]
When Arreat fell, we were still standing
Ash on our tongues and the dawn in our hands
We saved a world we could not shelter
And lost the mountain that taught us to stand
Carry the names, carry the names
Stone turns to dust but the oath remains

[Verse 3]
Tyrael stood where the red crystal bled
With the ruin of ages alive overhead
The Worldstone was taken far past our repair
And the weight of tomorrow hung thick in the air
His sword left his hand like a terrible star
And the heart of the mountain came falling apart
Through the last portal we stumbled alive
With a whole empty sky where our fathers stood high

[Bridge]
Where do the guardians go without a gate?
What do we guard when the rescue comes late?
The child on the road and the bread we can share
The names of the missing we speak to the air
Let Heaven remember the price of that flame
We will keep watch all the same

[Final Chorus]
When Arreat fell, we were still standing
Ash on our tongues and the dawn in our hands
We saved a world we could not shelter
And lost the mountain that taught us to stand
Carry the names, carry the names
Stone turns to dust but the oath remains

[Outro]
Carry the names through the cold and the rain
We will keep watch all the same

songs.title: Two Names in One Pair of Shoes

lyrics.text:
[Intro]
Keep the shoes.
Floor’s got teeth down here.
Come close enough to hear me—
I’m still fucking scared.

[Verse 1]
You drew a circle where the torchlight failed,
I watched the doorway, chewing on a nail.
Two empty stomachs and a busted blade,
Counting all the debts our bodies hadn’t paid.
You said Sylvian might hear us underneath.
I felt your answer shaking through your teeth.
No silver rings, no family in the room,
Just something breathing on the other side of doom.

[Pre-Chorus]
Is that a yes? Then take my hand.
I won’t pretend I understand.
If something answers when we call,
Will it remember us at all?

[Chorus]
Two names in one pair of shoes,
Tell me which of us we lose.
Love came down with a terrible grace,
Left your smile somewhere inside my face.
Fuck this dungeon, fuck its dues—
We’ve got one more door to bruise.
If I’m still here and you are too,
Which mouth says I love you?

[Verse 2]
The prayer went quiet, then the quiet bent.
I couldn’t tell you where my shoulder went.
Your childhood kitchen flashed behind my eyes;
I knew your mother’s voice and didn’t know why.
We stood too quickly on uncertain feet,
One pulse hammering a crooked beat.
I tried your name; it came out half of mine.
Some bastard laughed beyond the altar shrine.

[Pre-Chorus]
You hated thunder. I loved rain.
Now both come running through one brain.
The goddess gave us strength to stand.
I miss the distance to your hand.

[Chorus]
Two names in one pair of shoes,
Tell me which of us we lose.
Love came down with a terrible grace,
Left your smile somewhere inside my face.
Fuck this dungeon, fuck its dues—
We’ve got one more door to bruise.
If I’m still here and you are too,
Which mouth says I love you?

[Bridge]
Wait.
That little laugh was yours.
There—between the falling stones.
You always laughed when things got worse;
I hear it shaking through our bones.
We didn’t ask to be eternal.
We asked to see another day.
Help me lift this fucking door now.
Help me carry us away.

[Final Chorus]
Two names in one pair of shoes,
Both of us have paid our dues.
Love came down with a terrible grace;
Now the morning touches our strange face.
No more bargaining to do,
No clean miracle coming through.
With one breath where there once were two,
We say it: I love you.

[Outro]
Outside, we sit beside the road.
Untie the laces, drop the load.
Your laugh comes first. My answer follows.
We keep the shoes.
We walk tomorrow.

songs.title: Blood on My Shoes at Daybreak

lyrics.text:
[Intro — muttered, then sung]
Which shoe's mine? Both? That's unfortunate.
There was snow where my house used to stand.
Now there's something asleep in the cellar,
And an axe getting warm in my hand.

[Verse 1]
I came from the north with a name in my teeth,
With the names of my dead underneath.
Through the dungeon's mouth, down the wet stone throat,
Past a priest in a butcher's coat.
He said, kneel down, son, there's a power below.
I said, these shoes don't bend that low.
Took a drink for the courage I already had,
Spilled the rest on the stair. Waste of that.

[Pre-Chorus]
Something wearing a man's face smiled.
I remembered the face of my child.
Held my breath till the shaking passed;
Then I asked which prayer would be its last.

[Chorus]
Blood on my shoes, dawn in my eyes,
I've got one more dark thing to outlive tonight.
Call me a god if it helps you sleep;
I'm a man with a promise I mean to keep.
Open the shutters, uncover the light.
Something that hunted you died tonight.
Blood on my shoes, mud on the floor;
You won't hear that scratching anymore.

[Verse 2]
Ancient streets underneath the ground,
All that glory with nobody round.
I walked where the hungry reached up for a crown;
Kept my own two feet coming down.
Gold makes a terrible boot, you know.
Try running in that through the northern snow.
Ha—my left shoe's talking. It says we're through.
My right says there's work we've still got to do.

[Pre-Chorus]
Let the great ones bargain for endless years.
I've had plenty of time with fear.
There's a trail from this pit to the world outside,
And I'm following every stride.

[Chorus]
Blood on my shoes, dawn in my eyes,
I've got one more dark thing to outlive tonight.
Call me a god if it helps you sleep;
I'm a man with a promise I mean to keep.
Open the shutters, uncover the light.
Something that hunted you died tonight.
Blood on my shoes, mud on the floor;
You won't hear that scratching anymore.

[Bridge — half-time, exposed melody]
Bottle's empty. Keep it still.
For a second I can see our windowsill.
Little shoes drying beside the flame—
Don't make a chorus out of their names.
Let me hold them where the noise can't reach.
Let the silence finish what I can't speak.
Then lace these boots with a steady hand.
There's another village beyond this land.

[Final Chorus — rising intensity]
Blood on my shoes, dawn in my eyes,
I brought something mortal through endless night.
God of Ultra Violence, that's what they'll say;
I want children to walk home safe.
Open the shutters, uncover the light.
Something that hunted you died tonight.
Blood on my shoes, mud on the floor;
You won't hear that scratching anymore.

[Outro — gently sung]
At the last house, I leave them outside,
Those terrible shoes with the broken ties.
Morning comes. No claws at the door.
I set down the axe.
Sleep on. I'll keep watch.
